messages:
incident-bot: ALERT severity=sev2 hosted-api-us-east p95/p99 latency spike detected. queue_depth=4800, q_growth=+2400/min, gpu_util=99%, autoscaler_status=error
Alex Morgan: I'm on it. Seeing lots of 504s to customers, is this the same traffic pattern as last week?
Priya Kapoor: Not the same fingerprint. Origin header shows a single external partner sending bursts to /v1/generate with long contexts. They didn't use client token sharding.
Mateo Ruiz: Autoscaler logs show repeated failures to allocate new GPU nodes: "quota_exceeded: request for 8 gpus denied". Also an opaque race in scale-controller: crashloop on scale-controller-3.
Jenna SRE: stack traces: 
```
scale-controller/main.go:452 handleScaleRequest -> panic: nil pointer 
...
```
Ronan Cole: Can we short-circuit: set route fallback to smaller model (gpt-small-quant) for non-enterprise keys? That will reduce tokens and free capacity.
Alex Morgan: Good idea. Priya, can you push a routing override? We need to avoid impacting enterprise reserved customers.
Priya Kapoor: Pushing policy now. Command:
```
redwoodctl routes update --route /v1/generate --fallback-model gpt-small-quant --filter "tag!=enterprise"
```
Priya Kapoor: Policy applied. Starting to see tail latency drop for non-enterprise keys: p95 down ~40%. queue_depth still high on enterprise traffic.
Sarah Li: Customer support flags: 3 paying customers reporting timeouts and partial responses. Ticket IDs: #T-4321, #T-4322, #T-4325. Notifying account teams.
support-bot: Notified account teams for T-4321,T-4322,T-4325.
Mateo Ruiz: Manual scale attempt for enterprise pool is getting denied by cloud quota. Request submitted to cloud quota team but won't be instant. Logging: "quota-alloc: 0/32 available gpus in us-east-1"
Jenna SRE: Can we evict lower-priority batches and async jobs? There's a large background rerank job using GPUs in the same pool.
Alex Morgan: Yes, start eviction. Mateo, kill batch-job-1723 and drop its queue. That should free ~6 GPUs.
Mateo Ruiz: Killed batch-job-1723. Freed ~5.6 GPUs. enterprise queue still high but small improvement.
Ronan Cole: Also enabling temporary token-bucket throttling at ingress: 60rps per token for public keys. Applying WAF rule now.
Priya Kapoor: WAF rule applied. Public traffic p95 further improved. Enterprise customers still in backlog; plan B: route enterprise requests to dedicated failover pool (dedicated-fallback-1) that is currently cold. Need manual bring-up (50s warm).
Alex Morgan: Start cold pool bring-up. Command queued: 
```
infractl pool start dedicated-fallback-1 --region us-east-1 --gpu-count 8 --priority manual-override
```
Sarah Li: Communicating to affected enterprise customers: PSA in progress. Will give ETA ~2-3m for failover.
incident-bot: ACTION: sev2 declared. Pager to eng-oncall, eng-runtime, eng-sre. Handoff window started.
Mateo Ruiz: Pool is up. Routing rule flip in 1 iteration to send enterprise keys to dedicated-fallback-1. Flipping now.
Priya Kapoor: Flip done. Enterprise traffic draining into fallback pool. Latency p95 for enterprise moving from 18s -> 1.6s for requests that hit fallback. Some in-flight requests still time out.
Alex Morgan: Good. Keep throttles for public keys. Hold on autoscaler fix — Jenna, can you push a hotfix to avoid the nil panic in scale-controller? Quick patch to guard the pointer.
Jenna SRE: Pushing hotfix now (deploy 2.1.3-hotfix). Patch: 
```
if scaleReq == nil { log.Warn("nil scaleReq") ; return nil }
```
Jenna SRE: Hotfix deployed. No more crashloops observed in scale-controller-3. Autoscaler attempts now succeed but cloud quota still limit.
Ronan Cole: Notes: primary mitigations executed: routing fallback for public keys, WAF throttling, eviction of background GPU jobs, manual bring-up of dedicated pool, autoscaler hotfix.
Sarah Li: Support update sent to customers; providing link to status page: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/1735554321 with root cause summary and ETA.
Alex Morgan: Confirming all safety checks. queue_depth trending down to 200. p95/p99 back to normal for all routed traffic.
Mateo Ruiz: Follow-up: cloud quota request in progress, assigned ticket #CQ-9982. We'll request permanent increase and better headroom monitoring.
Priya Kapoor: Postmortem owner? I can own. Initial timeline: incident detection -> mitigations -> follow-ups (autoscaler fix roll, quota increase, routing policy review).
Jenna SRE: I'll add a test to scale-controller CI that simulates nil scaleReq path.
incident-bot: HANDOFF: On-call handoff to night team at 00:10 UTC. Current oncall: Alex Morgan -> Handoff to Mateo Ruiz (night).
Mateo Ruiz: Taking handoff. Will monitor queue for 60m and confirm quota increase status before morning. Setting alert: queue_depth>500 -> page eng-oncall.
Alex Morgan: Thanks team. We should run a targeted eval on the fallback model for quality drift and notify product if any customer-visible regressions.
Ronan Cole: Added to follow-ups.
Sarah Li: Closing customer comms loop; support triage will keep updates on the tickets.
incident-bot: INCIDENT CLOSED (status=mitigated) at 1735554790. Postmortem requested by Priya Kapoor.
